title: Review what Celerp AI wants to change
summary: Celerp AI proposes each change as a card you confirm or dismiss; nothing is written until you confirm it.

steps.text: Before the assistant changes anything in your books, it shows the change as a card naming what it wants to create, update or delete. The card also says when the change sends something outside Celerp, or finalizes or voids a document, and a change to many records comes as one card with their count and list.

Confirm applies the change and links to the record it created or updated; Dismiss discards the proposal and nothing is written. Confirm all applies every proposal from the same answer; if one fails, later changes to the same record stay pending with the reason while the others still run. Once every card is answered, the assistant carries on with your request.
A proposal that failed can be retried from the same card; one still waiting on something else shows why, so you know what to do next.
